checks.q: Is the endpoint address verified against LayerZero's official deployment?
Are trusted remote addresses correctly set and verified?
Is the message payload size validated to prevent DoS?
Are gas limits for destination execution properly configured?
Is the OApp implementation protected against message ordering attacks?
Are failed messages handled with a retry mechanism?
Is the DVN (Decentralized Verifier Network) configuration appropriate?
Are cross-chain token transfers protected against double-spending?
Is the composed message flow secure against reentrancy?
Are admin functions (like setting trusted remotes) properly access-controlled?
